```{r}
head(iris)
```

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
# Step 1: Define Decision Tree specs
tree_specs=decision_tree()|>
  set_engine("rpart") |>
  set_mode("classification")

# Step 2: cv plan
cv_plan=vfold_cv(iris,v=10)

# Step 3: fit resample (10-fold CV)
tree_model=fit_resamples(tree_specs,
                         Species~.,
                         cv_plan)

collect_metrics(tree_model)
```

```{r}
#Step 4: Fit model
tree_fit=fit(tree_specs,
             Species~.,
             iris)

library(rattle)
fancyRpartPlot(extract_fit_engine(tree_fit))
```

```{r}
#Step 1: Define model
rf_specs=rand_forest(mtry=tune())|>
  set_engine("ranger") |>
  set_mode("classification")

# Step 2: Already defined CV plan

#STep 3: Define tuning grid and fit
mtry_grid=grid_regular(
  mtry(range=c(1,4)),
  levels=4
)

rf_models=tune_grid(rf_specs,
                    Species~.,
                    cv_plan)
autoplot(rf_models)
```

```{r}
best_mtry=select_best(rf_models,metric="accuracy")
rf_final=finalize_model(rf_specs,best_mtry)
rf_fit=fit(rf_final,
           Species~.,
           iris)
```
